scoring.primary: Shared structural validation and fixed authored synthetic-oracle checks. Report oraclePassed, corrections and validation codes. Not human semantic verification.
scoring.parserOriginal: Trim whitespace, then accept exact JSON or a single whole-response ```json/``` fence. No object hunting, truncation repair, model repair or rescoring after edits. Preserve raw response.
scoring.rlmCompleteRequires: Complete workflow, non-null ledger, complete analysis trace, successful execute+slice evidence, and backend idle/liveWorkers0. No complete trace means no scored RLM ledger.
scoring.latency: Monotonic elapsed submit-to-result, excluding cold startup/shutdown; report timeouts separately and retain elapsed observations.

stopGates: Input/artifact drift or scope collision: stop before next admission.
Unknown child/group closure or non-idle retained backend after run disposal: stop and keep unrun rows NOT_RUN.
Any tool execution/approval/service mutation: stop, never approve.
Missing usage prevents efficiency claims; do not fabricate zero or drop rows.

Runner/transport/auth setup error or missing native packet: stop next admission; retain spent row and unrun rows. Native workflow error/deadline packets remain valid failed observations if cleanup is proven.
uncertainty: Four authored fixtures, one observation per arm/case; no blind sample, statistical speedup, billing or human-semantic claim.
